scope: qualification consistency only; no new trajectory execution or provenance changes
criteria: requires_transfer: an already correct concrete expected value or predicate can be retained while changing API, wrapper or stimulus; hardening print to assertion alone does not require new oracle inference.

requires_oracle_inference: the written recipe needs a new/corrected full value, vector, order, tree, membership or temporal-result relation from contract/source, even if its primitive matcher already exists.

A mixed recipe is classified conservatively at the highest oracle requirement among its alternatives; its compatibility still identifies branches with an existing correct oracle. This categorical choice is not a measured success percentage.
